package.description: Automatically pauses or lowers your music during the intense moments of a game and brings it back when it is safe.

en-US.description: Automatically pauses or lowers your music during the intense moments of a game and brings it back when it is safe.
en-US.longDescription:
AMM TriggerKit reacts to in-game events such as round starts, kills and deaths. It pauses your music or lowers its volume while you need to hear the game, then restores it afterwards. It works with Spotify, YouTube, browsers and other apps that appear in the Windows media controls.
The app is free and shows ads. The optional Pro Muter one-time purchase removes ads and adds extra features, and optional AMM Store packs are sold separately. Both are bought on the website.
en-US.name: AMM TriggerKit
